description.value: Unicorn Sparkles is a fine dining restaurant in downtown Victoria from the team behind acclaimed local spots hanks, nowhere, ate, and somewhere. It represents the group's attempt to bring together everything they've learned across those award-winning projects into a single new venture. Touring cyclists passing through the heart of Victoria will find it at unit G4 on Douglas Street, with reservations recommended.
